# docs/memory/api/

<!-- Generated by php tools/memory_index.php, except the key rules between the two marker lines, which are written by hand. -->

External API (integration.php, includes/api/): endpoints, scopes, device and OAuth sessions, MCP server, webhooks, outbound connectors, connected accounts.

## Key rules

<!-- key-rules:start -->
- Declare an endpoint once, as a row in `api_schema()` or the module's `includes/<module>/api.php`: router, validator, OpenAPI, MCP tools and scope screen all read it (`api-endpoint-rules.md`).
- Put a new scope in `api_scope_groups()` and in its owner ceiling: `api_owner_scopes()` for a core scope, the module's `erp_`/`ws_`/`translate_owner_scopes()` for a module, or every call answers 403 (`external-api-authorization.md`).
- Give an endpoint whose screen narrows rows for the user role (3) the same row rule, 404 outside: the scope alone opens every row (`api-user-role-rows.md`).
- Read the caller as `api_current_app()['owner']`; give `'public' => true` only to the token routes; a device or OAuth connection never holds `webhooks:manage` (`api-device-sessions.md`).
- Read input only through `api_request_input()` and `api_header()`, since MCP runs handlers in-process; a route an OAuth client cannot use carries `'mcp' => false` (`api-mcp-server.md`).
- Call `api_dry_run_stop()` directly above the first write, after every check: an early stop promises a check that never ran (`api-dry-run.md`).
- Never rely on PATCH or DELETE (IIS answers both 405): updates are POST with `also_accepts` PATCH, deletes get a `POST …/delete` twin whose id ends in `_post` (`external-api-iis-environment.md`).
- Keep a text field's `max_length` within its varchar column: the non-strict session cuts the rest in silence and the client still gets 200 (`api-text-field-limits.md`).
- Announce with `pg_announce()` and a name listed in `api_webhook_events()` (an unknown name is dropped silently), never from a bulk import (`api-webhook-events.md`).
- Keep OAuth tokens as `api_devices` rows and outgoing tokens behind `pg_connect_*()`: no token table, file or config column, and never read a refresh token (`api-connected-accounts.md`).
<!-- key-rules:end -->

## Files

- `INDEX.md` lists the files of this folder, one line each: search it rather than read it whole, then open only the files that match.
- `grep -i 'word' docs/memory/api/INDEX.md`; across every folder: `grep -i 'word' docs/memory/*/INDEX.md`.
